column3: Match me?{pause_20_skippable} You can't even\nimagine what I carry.{end_now}
You still want to fight?\nThen you're fools, and\nI am sorry for it.{end_wait}
Then so be it. Come, and\nlearn what I must do!{end_wait}
I must finish this\nquickly... Come at me!{end_wait}
I'm going with\n{actor_name:1}. They need me.{end_wait}
I wish I could stay.\nBut there's more\nI have to do.{end_wait}
Very well. Imil is in your\nhands, Megan, Justin.{end_wait}
